profile_text.body:
ElevenLabs is a New York-based AI voice technology company founded in 2022. The company describes itself as building foundational models, beginning with what it calls the first human-like voice model, and now extending beyond voice into broader communication and creation tools. Its platform offers an AI voice generator and voice agents platform providing access to more than 5,000 voices in 70 or more languages through APIs and SDKs, with products organized around ElevenAgents for customer experience and ElevenCreative for content creation. The company describes its text-to-speech models as independently rated leading, with options optimized for consistency, latency, or emotional control, supporting 29 or more languages.

The site tracks ElevenLabs under the Voice and Audio category, noting voice cloning and likeness and consent risk as notable considerations associated with the product. The company carries a New York law-exposure entry with a count of 299 cases, which reflects the volume of legal activity in that jurisdiction associated with the company in the site's records, though no specific litigation cases are detailed in the held facts.
